summary: Approved iteration `authenticated-dashboard-shell`. Source review confirms the delivery satisfies the iteration objectives: `/dashboard` is protected with Auth.js session enforcement and redirects unauthenticated users to `/sign-in?callbackUrl=/dashboard`; sign-in and registration flows target `/dashboard`; Home is the default dashboard page with a welcome message; the shell includes collapsible Home, Feedback Request, and Configure navigation; Feedback Request and Configure are protected placeholders; top-right session controls show user identity, provide Auth.js logout back to `/`, and include an icon-only persisted light/dark theme toggle. Fresh approved checks passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`; `npx.cmd prisma validate`; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; `npm.cmd run lint`; and `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-delivery-behavior.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\dashboard\dashboard-authenticated-shell-source.test.mjs` with 17/17 passing. Production build, browser verification, Playwright, e2e tests, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real email sending were not run per task constraints and are not claimed as passed.
